leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a CSS Grid container by applying the display: grid property
Configure grid template columns using fixed, flexible, and fractional units
Construct grid template rows to define the vertical structure of your layout
Implement grid template areas to create named layout regions
Manipulate grid gap properties to control spacing between rows and columns
Apply grid auto-flow to control how auto-placed items fill the grid
Integrate grid template shorthand to efficiently define the complete grid structure
